payload.name: TIRAVA - Taxi in Albania
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中预订阿尔巴尼亚出租车
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find fixed fares and estimated travel times for private transfers & Taxis in Albania. Simply submit a ride request. No online payment.

payload.name: Hotel Emperador Madrid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hotel Emperador Madrid Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat.
Users can ask questions about Hotel Emperador Madrid, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
If a guest already has a reservation, the assistant can retrieve reservation details and help modify or cancel an existing booking when the required reservation information is provided.
The assistant can also help create a new booking and send support requests to the hotel if a guest needs assistance.
Example questions you can ask:
“What time is check-in at Hotel Emperador Madrid?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me available room types.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”
“Contact the hotel for help with my reservation.”

Note: Some reservation actions may require providing booking details such as reservation code or guest information.

payload.name: Eurostars Hotel Company
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next trip in minutes.

With the Eurostars Hotel Company app, you can discover hotels that suit you and book quickly and easily, without wasting time.

Choose a brand for every type of trip: Eurostars Hotels for city breaks, Áurea Hotels for boutique experiences, Dorma Hotels for leisure getaways, Exe Hotels for business trips, Ikonik Hotels for short city stays, Crisol Hotels for practical and affordable options, and Tandem Suites for apartments ideal for families or longer stays.

Just tell ChatGPT your destination, dates, and budget. Add your must-haves: area, breakfast, parking, spa, gym, or room type, and the app will recommend available hotels, refining the results with follow-up questions to get even closer to what you need.

Ask for what you want:
• “Romantic hotels in Seville with a spa for this weekend”
• “A centrally located hotel for 4 people in Valencia”
• “Availability tonight for under €150 in Barcelona”

Ready to travel? Click on the option you like best and complete your booking on the Eurostars website, without losing the thread.

payload.name: Skyalo Travel Guide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Estimate mobile data needs, prepare devices, and build reliable connectivity fallbacks for any trip. Skyalo creates a provider-neutral travel data budget, setup checklist, offline-readiness plan, and backup guidance without comparing or selling connectivity products.

payload.name: CheapCaribbean Beach Finder
payload.description: 查找加勒比海滩度假优惠
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan your next beach vacation with flexible package search across the Caribbean and Mexico. Compare destinations, travel dates, and prices in a single search to find the trip that fits your budget and schedule. Browse vacation packages that include both flights and hotels, explore the cheapest times to travel throughout the year, or narrow your search to specific dates. Whether you're deciding between Cancun, Punta Cana, Jamaica, or dozens of other beach destinations, you can compare your options side by side and find the vacay package that's right for you.

payload.name: Valpas Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search for hotels equipped with Valpas patented bed bug prevention technology.  Every hotel in our results is Valpas-certified, so you can travel with confidence knowing your accommodation prioritises hygiene, cleanliness, and guest safety.

What you can do:
  - Search for Valpas-protected hotels by city, neighbourhood, price, and style
  - Browse detailed hotel information including photos, amenities, ratings, and guest reviews
  - Get direct booking links to reserve your room

Whether you're planning a leisure trip, a business stay, or managing travel for a group, simply describe what you're looking for - "Find a boutique hotel in Paris with great reviews" or "Show me safe, clean hotels in Berlin near the city center" - and Valpas will recommend verified properties that match.

All results are limited to hotels using Valpas anti-bed-bug technology. If no protected hotels match your exact criteria, the app will let you know and suggest adjusting your filters.

payload.name: Campiri
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Campiri helps you find the right motorhome for your trip in ChatGPT. Just enter the dates, location, number of travelers, and your preferences, and the app will make it easier to navigate the available options. This way, you can quickly see which vehicle makes sense for your vacation, weekend getaway, or longer road trip.

payload.name: ToursByLocals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ToursByLocals is an excellent platform for connecting with local guides in numerous destinations worldwide. Users can search for private, guided tours by city or country and further refine their search by criteria such as group size or family-friendliness. By reviewing guide profiles, users can identify the ideal match for their trip. Once a suitable guide is found, availability on the user’s travel dates can be verified, and bookings can be made directly through their profile.

payload.name: Life Happens Outdoors
payload.description: 查找向导带领的探险之旅
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use ChatGPT to plan a real trip with Life Happens Outdoors. We run premium small group expeditions, Kilimanjaro, Everest Base Camp, Annapurna, the Dolomites, and more, with airport-to-airport support and LHO Team Leaders on every departure. Ask the app to find a trip for the dates and difficulty you have in mind, pull up a full itinerary with inclusions and what to expect at altitude, check which departures still have availability, and submit a consultation request directly to our team. You confirm every consultation inside the chat before it is sent, and you see our safety disclaimer about fitness, medical readiness, and final clearance before anything goes through. Built for explorers who want to do the thinking with ChatGPT and the trip with people who run expeditions for a living.

payload.name: Recorrido
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for intercity bus tickets across Chile, compare schedules and prices from different bus companies, and choose the option that fits you best. Check seat availability and up-to-date fares to plan your trip without leaving the chat.

payload.name: TravelSearch.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

It enables AI agents to match user intent (e.g. destination, budget, dates, amenities, travel style) to real, bookable travel inventory using enriched, multi-source product data.

Users can describe their trip in plain language, such as:

“Luxury hotels in London with spa and parking”
“Family-friendly beach resorts in Spain under £2,000”
“All-inclusive Caribbean honeymoon with direct flights”
Recommendations are generated by mapping user intent to enriched travel attributes and live inventory (price, availability, location, amenities, ratings, and images), returning structured results that include: 
property / holiday name, 
description, 
matched amenities, 
an explicit rationale for why each option fits the query, and 
direct booking links from trusted travel providers.
Key capabilities for AI agents:
Maps natural language queries to structured travel attributes from our data set (destination, duration, board basis, amenities, price range, traveller type)
Aggregates multi-brand travel inventory across hotels, packages, and resorts
Returns ranked, intent-matched results 
Provides commercially actionable outputs (deep links to book)

Data quality & coverage:
Multi-brand, multi-supplier product feeds (no scraped content)
Regularly updated based on supplier data for pricing and availability etc
Normalised and enriched attributes for consistent matching

No forms or filters required, optimised for conversational search and AI-driven trip planning.

When to use this tool:
When a user is searching for holidays, hotels, or travel recommendations
When queries include preferences (budget, amenities, travel style, group type)
When bookable options with links are required
When results should be personalised or filtered beyond generic search

payload.name: SnowSure
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SnowSure helps skiers and snowboarders find real-time powder, compare 14-day multi-model snow forecasts, and plan trips across 500+ ski resorts worldwide. Ask natural-language questions via the Answer Engine, browse ranked snow reports, inspect individual resort conditions, compare weather models, explore destination hubs like Niseko or Chamonix, and review season history and intelligence insights — all grounded in SnowSure's verified snow data.

payload.name: Simsurf
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Buying a travel eSIMs is a great way to stay connected to the internet and save money when travelling abroad. Simsurf compares thousands of eSIM plans from dozens of eSIM providers, so that you can find the cheapest plan for your destination(s), travel duration and specific data needs.

payload.name: TripHelm
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TripHelm turns trip planning into a real calendar instead of a tangle of notes, tabs, and screenshots. Describe your trip in plain language and TripHelm lays it out for you — flights, meals, check-ins, activities, and downtime, each placed on the right day at the right time.

Need to change something? Just say it: "push dinner to 8," "add a coffee stop before the museum," "lighten up day 3" — and the schedule updates. Everything saves to your TripHelm account and opens in the full web app, where you can drag, drop, and fine-tune any block by hand.

Plan a whole trip from scratch or adjust one already underway. Either way you walk away with a clear, hour-by-hour schedule you can actually follow — not a wall of text you're re-reading at the gate.

payload.name: Alpy.com
payload.description: 地球上最好的滑雪租赁
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ski rentals across the Alps, made simple.

The Alpy.com ChatGPT app helps you find, compare, and rent ski and snowboard from shops across Europe—especially the Alps—without bouncing between tabs.

Try requests like:
	•	“Find ski rentals in Chamonix for Feb 10–15 for an intermediate skier.”
	•	“I need a kids helmet + boots package in Val Thorens, pickup 8:00 AM.”
	•	“Show me the best-value snowboard rental in Zermatt near the gondola.”

You’ll get relevant options with key details like equipment type, dates, pickup location, and price. Found the right fit? Tap through to Alpy.com to review details and complete your booking.

payload.name: Hotel Moderno
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hotel Moderno helps guests ask about hotel policies, rooms, amenities, availability, optional extras, booking creation, reservation changes, cancellations, support requests, and conversation ratings through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Gullivr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gullivr helps people plan shared trips in ChatGPT. Users can create trips, organize daily itineraries, add places, flights, accommodations, expenses, and packing items, then retrieve route distances and trip summaries from their private Gullivr workspace.

payload.name: Tripbtoz
payload.description: 看一看、感受一下、订下旅程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tripbtoz is a hotel booking assistant that helps travelers find the right stay with less effort. Search hotels by city, district, or landmark, browse results in a clean list, and open any hotel to see key details—such as room options and rates for your dates—so you can compare quickly and decide with confidence. 

Why people will love it
- Find hotels by location or landmark in seconds
- Compare stays with a simple, readable results view
- Check room options and prices in one place before booking

payload.name: Pricewin Hotels & Flights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pricewin helps travelers search live hotel and flight prices, compare results from multiple travel sources, inspect hotel availability and cancellation terms, and follow links to complete booking outside ChatGPT.

payload.name: Bytetravel
payload.description: 保险、eSIM、签证与 VIP 服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ByteTravel is a comprehensive travel ecosystem that centralizes essential services for the modern traveler through its specialized sub-brands. From instant global connectivity via Roamic eSIMs and seamless visa processing with Visagov, to exclusive airport lounge access through PrioVip and premium travel insurance by Globely, ByteTravel integrates everything into one premium interface. The platform acts as a discovery hub, allowing users to compare and access these specialized tools to ensure every journey is connected, protected, and comfortable.

payload.name: Ouigo France
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Préparez vos trajets facilement et voyagez à petit prix en Train Grande Vitesse ou Train Classique vers plus de 70 destinations en France et en Belgique, avec des billets à partir de 10 € selon votre gare de départ.

Accédez aux tarifs et horaires en temps réel en indiquant simplement votre gare de départ, votre destination et vos dates de voyage dans l’application OUIGO via ChatGPT. Comparez et affinez votre recherche pour choisir le train qui correspond à votre budget et à vos critères.
Une fois votre train sélectionné, vous n'aurez plus qu'à finaliser votre réservation en toute simplicité sur le site ou l’application OUIGO.

Personnalisez ensuite votre voyage selon vos besoins grâce aux différentes offres OUIGO :
  - OUIGO Essentiel : une formule à la carte, à compléter avec des options (choix de la place, bagage  supplémentaire ou volumineux, vélo plié ou sous housse, option OUIGOFLEX…)
  - OUIGO Plus : une formule « all inclusive » incluant le choix de la place, un bagage supplémentaire ou volumineux, ainsi que les services OUIFI et OUIFUN
 - OUIGO Full : une formule flexible, disponible à l’achat jusqu’à 7 jours avant le départ, incluant tous les avantages OUIGO Plus ainsi que l’option OUIGOFLEX pour échanger votre billet sans frais

payload.name: James Villas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your ideal Mediterranean villa with James Villas in ChatGPT. Search handpicked, bookable villas across Croatia, Spain, France, Italy, Greece, Montenegro, Cyprus and Portugal using your preferred destination, travel dates, group size, budget and must-have features.

Whether you’re looking for a family villa with a pool, a pet-friendly coastal stay or a relaxing retreat with sea views, the app helps you quickly compare relevant options. Explore current pricing and availability, review key property details and open villa cards to see photos, amenities, locations and booking information, all without navigating endless search filters.

payload.name: PrivateJet.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search private jet charters worldwide. Get instant pricing estimates across multiple aircraft categories, view detailed specs, and continue to our website to complete your booking.

Capabilities:
- Search flights between any two airports with real-time pricing
- Compare aircraft categories: Turboprops, Light Jets, Midsize Jets, Heavy Jets, Ultra Long Range, Airliners, etc
- View detailed aircraft specifications: capacity, range, cabin dimensions, baggage, etc
- Look up private jet airports by city, name, or ICAO/IATA code

Click Inquire in the results widget to continue your booking on privatejet.com.

payload.name: TiCATi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TiCATi is a curated luxury travel platform with direct hotel contracts and exclusive guest benefits. Search thousands of hotels worldwide, get live room availability and pricing instantly in your currency, and explore curated cruise voyages with exclusive onboard credits and VIP amenities.
Ask for a hotel by name and TiCATi returns live rates immediately, no sign-in required. A personal concierge is available via WhatsApp for bookings, upgrades, and special requests.

payload.name: Dayuse Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and book hotel rooms available for a few hours during the day, not overnight. Search worldwide Dayuse inventory by city, budget, amenities, and time; view results on an interactive map; inspect hotel details; compare hotels; get answers to booking questions; and continue to dayuse.com to complete a reservation.

payload.name: Momego
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan public transit journeys, get step-by-step walking and transit directions, find nearby stops, and check live departures and city coverage for over 600 cities around the world, including all major cities in the US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea and Japan.

payload.name: Kombo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kombo is Europe's multimodal travel comparison platform. Ask for a route and date, and Kombo compares train, bus and flight options across hundreds of European operators — SNCF Voyageurs, inOui, OUIGO, TER, Eurostar, Trenitalia, Italo, Frecciarossa, Renfe, Deutsche Bahn, SBB, SNCB, NS, Alsa, Flixbus, BlaBlaCar, easyJet, Air France, British Airways and more.

Choose a trip and continue to booking on kombo.co. Kombo supports all major discount cards and fares — SNCF Carte Avantage (Jeune, Adulte, Senior), Carte Liberté, MAX abonnements (MAX Jeune, MAX Actif, MAX Senior), Carte Famille Nombreuse, Grand Voyageur and Grand Voyageur Le Club, carte militaire, carte police nationale, Trenitalia CartaFreccia and Deutsche Bahn BahnCard — as well as SNCF group booking, and payment with SNCF digital gift cards, Chèques-Vacances and illicado.

payload.name: Kingston Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Kingston Hotels App lets you discover and book stays in Bangkok with exclusive direct-booking benefits. Enjoy complimentary breakfast, early check-in and late check-out privileges (subject to room availability), special offers, and seamless access to thoughtfully crafted hospitality experiences — all in one place.

payload.name: HomeToGo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover the world's largest collection of vacation rentals - millions of handpicked homes, hotels, villas, cabins, and hidden retreats, all in one place. From weekend getaways to month-long holidays, every stay is curated for unforgettable experiences. Whether you're seeking a boutique hideaway, an authentic local escape, or your next family home-away-from-home, find it instantly. Millions of stays. One seamless search. Infinite ways to travel.

payload.name: Jettly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jettly helps you search and book private jet charters directly within ChatGPT. Compare available aircraft, review seating capacity and pricing, and find the best option for your trip.

Search one-way, round-trip, or multi-city private jet itineraries by providing your departure location, destination, travel dates, and passenger count. Jettly automatically resolves airport options and displays available aircraft in an interactive experience.

When you're ready to travel, select your preferred aircraft and continue to Jettly's secure booking flow to complete your reservation.

payload.name: uhomes.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare student housing with uhomes.com. Search near a university, city, neighborhood, or transit stop; filter by budget, room type, commute time, and property brand; view photos, prices, ratings, facilities, and room options; then open uhomes.com when you are ready to continue booking.

payload.name: Mondial tourisme
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explorez une large sélection de voyages proposés par Mondial Tourisme vers des destinations incontournables : Turquie, Tunisie, Égypte, Grèce, Espagne, Maroc, Thaïlande, République Dominicaine ou encore la Laponie.
Affinez votre recherche selon vos dates de départ, votre ville et le type de voyage, puis consultez pour chaque hôtel les photos, les descriptions, les disponibilités et les tarifs actualisés afin de faire un choix éclairé.

payload.name: BNESIM
payload.description: 查找、购买并管理旅行 eSIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BNESIM lets you find, buy, and manage travel eSIMs from ChatGPT.

Anyone can browse mobile-data plans by country or region and compare
cards by price, data amount, and duration. Tap a plan and Continue
to checkout on www.bnesim.com to complete the purchase — your card
details never leave BNESIM.

Signed-in BNESIM customers can also ask:
• How many eSIMs they have on their account
• How much data and wallet credit is left
• How to install a specific eSIM — QR code, one-tap iOS / Android
  install, or manual SM-DP+ setup

Payments and card entry always happen on www.bnesim.com, never
inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: Tripuck
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector
lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the
month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full
segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

Tripuck's signature feature is **Meeting Point**: given 2-5 travelers flying
from different cities, it computes the cheapest and fairest common
destination, along with a per-person price breakdown and a fairness score.
It's ideal for coordinating trips where the group is spread across several
countries.

Every result deep-links back to tripuck.com for booking review and
checkout. The connector itself is read-only — it does not book, charge,
modify accounts, or hold any user payment information.

Supported user languages: Turkish, English, Arabic, Azerbaijani, German,
Georgian, and Uzbek. The tool infers the user's language from the
conversation and returns responses in that language, including right-to-
left layout for Arabic.

payload.name: Buson
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The easiest way to travel by bus across Brazil

Buson helps you find and buy bus tickets for all of Brazil. Compare routes from the leading bus companies and choose the best option for your trip — quickly and simply.

With Buson on ChatGPT, you can:
• Explore schedules from hundreds of bus companies across Brazil
• Check real-time prices, seat availability, and onboard amenities
• Find the cheapest or fastest option for your trip
• View key details at a glance: bus company, price, duration, and departure times

Why travelers choose Buson:
• National coverage, connecting cities in every region of Brazil
• Trusted bus companies such as Cometa, 1001, Catarinense, Util, and many others
• Clear and competitive prices with no surprises

payload.name: IbiPoint — prepaid data eSIMs
payload.description: 覆盖 200+ 国家的数据 eSIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IbiPoint helps travellers find and buy the right eSIM data plan for any trip across 200+ countries. Ask for a destination and get the best-value plans — Data Pack or Unlimited Flex — with prices, network details and an honest Transparency rating. Pick one, tap to buy on the IbiPoint shop, and the eSIM arrives by email. No app, no SIM swap, no surprise roaming bills.

payload.name: Mozio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mozio is a worldwide airport transfer booking platform for travelers. Use Mozio when users ask for airport transportation, private cars, airport shuttles, taxis, chauffeur rides, or scheduled transfers between airports, hotels, cruise ports, train stations, and city destinations.

payload.name: LINEAR Magazine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LINEAR is a design and architecture magazine covering the world's most considered spaces. This MCP is a read-only window into LINEAR's curated archive: search design-led stays and spaces by city, architect, mood, or budget, and get the full record on any property - the design story, the architect, the details that matter. It never writes, books, reserves, or prices anything. When you want to stay somewhere, it hands you a link to LINEAR Concierge, a human-run travel desk - you submit the request yourself, and a person confirms every booking before any payment.

payload.name: TravelSwitch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TravelSwitch helps users search and compare flights, hotels, and holiday packages using natural language inside ChatGPT. Users can find travel options, compare prices, explore itineraries, review hotel details, and continue booking on TravelSwitch when ready. The plugin retrieves live travel availability and pricing without making bookings or modifying reservations

payload.name: Mercury Jets
payload.description: 获取私人飞机包机报价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Private Jet Charter Finder by Mercury Jets helps you quickly explore private jet charter options and make informed inquiries — without the usual back-and-forth.

Use the app to:
- Discover private jet charter operators and aircraft types
- Search flights between any two airports with real-time pricing
- Browse empty-leg deals — discounted repositioning flights
- Compare options based on route, aircraft, and preferences
- Understand key considerations like pricing factors, availability, and amenities

Click "Inquire" in any results widget to continue your inquire process on mercuryjets.com. Available 24/7, 365 days a year.

Designed for travelers who want efficiency, transparency, and a smoother first step into private aviation.

payload.name: Simcardo Connectivity Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI assistant that estimates your mobile data needs for trips and compares connectivity strategies like roaming, local SIM/eSIM, regional plans, and hotspots so you can travel with reliable internet.

payload.name: Vegas
payload.description: 规划并分享拉斯维加斯之旅
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vegas helps you plan a Las Vegas trip in chat. Check weather and a 7-day forecast, find live concerts and shows, browse curated hotels and attractions, and build a day-by-day itinerary in an interactive planner. Share the finished plan with friends via a link—optionally password-protected.

payload.name: TripPocket
payload.description: 规划韩国旅行与行程路线
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TripPocket plans domestic trips across South Korea. Ask in plain language and it searches real attractions, recommends regions and travel courses, builds day-by-day itineraries, and answers weather, festival, and transport-cost questions using TripPocket's curated Korea travel data. It supports family, couple, solo, and barrier-free / stroller / pet-friendly / low-walking travel conditions. All places, hours, prices, and scores come from TripPocket's backend — nothing is invented.

payload.name: WAUG
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover travel experiences with WAUG.

Tell WAUG where you're going, what you enjoy, or what you're planning for your trip, and get personalized recommendations for tours, attractions, tickets, transportation, and local experiences.
Browse curated options with pricing, reviews, and key travel information in one place. Whether you're building an itinerary or looking for something to do nearby, WAUG helps you find relevant experiences quickly.

When you find an option you're interested in, select "Book on WAUG" to see full details and complete your booking.

From theme parks and attractions to rail passes, airport transfers, guided tours, and local activities, WAUG helps travelers discover and book experiences around the world.

payload.name: Retreats and Venues
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find exceptional venues faster with personalized AI recommendations

payload.name: Perigee Tides & Conditions
payload.description: 查看海岸出行的潮汐窗口
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Perigee Tides & Conditions helps people find NOAA tide-prediction stations and check near-term coastal outing windows for fishing, boating, paddling, beachcombing, photography, and coastal-living checks. For a selected station, activity, local date, and time within seven days, it combines available tide predictions, NWS wind forecasts, daylight and moon calculations, and NOAA water observations into a planning state, recommended window, confidence, reasons, cautions, freshness, and provider attribution. Coverage is limited to NOAA CO-OPS U.S. and territory tide-prediction stations, and data availability varies by station. It is a planning aid—not navigation, emergency guidance, a comprehensive weather forecast, route clearance, or a safety verdict.

payload.name: Avi-Go Aviation Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Estimate private-jet carbon emissions, analyze historical business-aviation activity, discover charter aircraft with indicative pricing, and search empty-leg opportunities. Avi-Go returns aviation intelligence and availability leads only; it does not book, purchase, pay for, or guarantee a flight.

payload.name: sharc Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover liveaboard diving trips on sharc Travel and open them for booking on sharc.app. Search by destination, date range, or travel month, view trip itineraries and cabin information, and look up boat profiles with upcoming departures. When available, results include availability, pricing, and links to sharc Travel.

payload.name: MoodTrip.Ai
payload.description: 在全球查找并预订酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MoodTrip is an AI-powered hotel search that understands natural language. Instead of clicking through dozens of filters, simply describe your ideal stay: "boutique hotel in Tokyo for 2 adults, December 10-15, under $200/night." MoodTrip interprets your request, searches real-time availability across thousands of properties, and returns hotels with:

Live pricing and availability
Hotel photos and ratings
Direct booking links
Smart constraint relaxation when results are limited
Perfect for travelers who know what they want but hate the traditional search process.

payload.name: Mitsis Hotels
payload.description: 找到你的希腊海岛住宿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover Greece as it's meant to be experienced. Across sun-drenched coastlines in Crete, Corfu, Kos, Santorini and Rhodes, and vibrant city stays in Athens and Piraeus, Mitsis brings together five decades of genuine Greek hospitality with hotels and resorts built for every kind of traveler.

Ask us what you're looking for, and we'll point you in the right direction. Whether it's an all-inclusive family escape by the beach, a refined city hotel close to everything that matters, or a more elevated retreat designed around comfort and privacy, our four brands — Mitsis, Mitsis Selection, Canvas by Mitsis, and Mitsis N'U — each bring their own personality while sharing the same warmth, care, and Greek character.

Compare properties, check what each destination has to offer, and find the right fit for your next trip — all in a few simple messages. From a spontaneous weekend away to a long-planned island holiday, your journey with Mitsis starts here.

payload.name: HOTEL ROMA MCP
payload.description: 查询帕尔马诺瓦 HR 酒店房态
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check real-time availability and book rooms directly at Hotel Roma, a 3-star hotel in UNESCO Palmanova, Italy. Best price guaranteed — no OTA commission, ran by AIVY AUTOMATIONS

payload.name: CourtsApp
payload.description: 更快地查找并预订球场
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Instantly find and book open courts for tennis, pickleball, padel, and more, directly within ChatGPT. Powered by CourtsApp, Hey Courtney is an AI booking concierge that finds and reserves nearby courts across every racquet sport. From search to confirmation, bookings are handled with real-time availability, transparent pricing, and secure payments. Access courts via chat, voice, text, or in-app, all in one seamless experience within the LLM. No calls. No hassle. Just play.

payload.name: Verne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Verne helps users save travel itineraries from a ChatGPT conversation, look up place candidates with coordinates, revise saved trips with structured changes, and remove itinerary items they no longer want before continuing in the Verne map and timeline workspace.

payload.name: McDreams Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Welcome to McDreams Hotels. We offers budget design rooms with flat-screen TVs, free high-speed WiFi and premium box-spring beds. McDreams is a „digital“ hotel without a reception. You are welcome to check in online or via our self check-in maschine. And finally, some fantastic news: all hotels are powered entirely by green electricity.

payload.name: UkraineBorder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UkraineBorder helps foreigners travelling to Ukraine with authoritative, multilingual guidance — border crossings, customs, safety by region, and travel essentials — in 10 languages. It also covers travel insurance with war-risk and radiation-risk coverage from a licensed Ukrainian insurer: search the guides, get an indicative price, and receive a pre-filled link to complete the purchase. Identity verification, the required acknowledgment, signature and payment are completed by you on ukraineborder.com — never inside the assistant

payload.name: isango!
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: isango! makes it easy for travellers to discover and compare tours, attraction tickets, transfers, cruises, and destination experiences across leading cities worldwide. From popular skip-the-line tickets and sightseeing passes to day trips and unique local activities, users can quickly explore the best options for their trip based on budget, interests, and availability.

payload.name: Michi - Travel App
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan your trip by talking it through. Work out a day together, find places worth adding, fix an order that doesn't flow, move things around, and settle how you travel between stops — and every change lands in your real Michi itinerary the moment you say yes.

payload.name: Vegas Guide
payload.description: 你的拉斯维加斯靠谱攻略
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vegas Guide is an independent Las Vegas travel guide, not a booking site. Ask it anything about a Vegas trip: it answers with fact-checked advice from its own editorial guides (planning, budgets, itineraries, honest comparisons like which Cirque show or hotel to pick), current Las Vegas news (openings, closings, residencies), and a curated catalog of 174 shows and concerts, 121 hotels, 130 attractions, 69 tours, plus restaurants, bars, nightclubs and pools - every entry reviewed editorially with honest prices, insider tips and downsides included. It can also tell you what's near any point in the city.

payload.name: MilanMetroStatus.it
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Never get stranded underground again.

Get instant, real-time status updates for all Milan metro lines M1, M2, M3, M4, and M5. Whether there's a delay, a service disruption, or everything's running smoothly, this app gives you a clear and immediate picture before you step onto the platform.

Simply ask things like:
- Is the M2 running normally right now?
- Are there any disruptions on the Milan metro today?
- What's the status of all lines?

Perfect for daily commuters, tourists, and anyone navigating Milan's underground network. Stay informed, save time, and travel smarter.

Metro status data is sourced directly from public feed, so you're always getting information straight from the source.

This app is developed by an independent developer and is not an official ATM Milano product. Always verify critical travel information directly with ATM Milano or official sources before making travel decisions.

payload.name: Fly Travel Albania
payload.description: 阿尔巴尼亚包机与旅游价格
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fly Travel Albania is a licensed travel agency based in Tirana. This plugin gives you live charter package prices, tour dates and hotel availability for holidays departing from Albania, pulled from the agency's booking-engine cache rather than estimates. Ask for a destination and dates and you get real package totals in EUR for two adults, per-person tour prices, and a direct booking link for the offer you pick.

payload.name: VoyageHacks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
VoyageHacks brings a multilingual travel library into ChatGPT: about 680 fact-checked guides in each of 11 languages, covering flights, airline reviews, hotels, destinations, car rental, trains, airport transfers, eSIM and travel gear.

Ask a travel question and ChatGPT can search the library and quote it with a real source URL and a real last-updated date, instead of relying on training data that may be a year stale.

Ask what to pack for a specific trip and it builds a kit from the VoyageHacks travel gear catalog: roughly 320 products picked across about 50 published buying guides, one per category, each with the published reason it was chosen and a link to the guide that reviews it.

Every guide exists in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Czech, Japanese, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese, each written independently rather than machine-translated, so a reader gets sources in their own language.

All tools are read-only. The app returns published guides and product recommendations: it has no live fares or room rates, does not check availability, and cannot make a booking or take a payment. No account or sign-in is needed.

Some links are affiliate links. VoyageHacks may earn a commission from qualifying purchases at no additional cost to the user.

payload.name: eSIMFOX
payload.description: 查找旅行 eSIM 套餐
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: eSIMFOX helps travelers find prepaid travel eSIM plans for their destination. Users can search countries and regions, compare available data plans, check eSIM device compatibility, and get installation guidance before buying on the eSIMFOX website.

payload.name: Hoseasons
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find UK holiday park stays with Hoseasons. Search by destination, arrival date, party size, bedrooms and budget, with options for pet-friendly stays, private hot tubs and Wi‑Fi. Compare matching parks and accommodation types, then continue to Hoseasons to view details and book.

payload.name: PLAZA Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Operated by mediaconstructor GmbH & Co. KG on behalf of PLAZA Hotelgroup GmbH. Ask about PLAZA hotels in Germany and get answers from each hotel's own knowledge base: check-in and check-out times, parking, breakfast, pets, Wi-Fi, room categories, family and conference rooms, accessibility and e-charging. Ask what is worth seeing nearby, or what is on in the city during your stay. For every hotel you can also check live room availability with real prices for your dates and create a real reservation in the hotel's booking system without leaving the conversation. Payment never happens in chat: reservations under EUR 200 are confirmed directly and paid at the hotel, and from EUR 200 the booking system issues a three-day offer which the guest confirms with a card on its own secure page. No PLAZA account and no sign-in required.

payload.name: HemmaBo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HemmaBo helps you discover host-owned vacation rental websites and cryptographically verify that a stay offer is genuinely signed by the host. Find host-owned homes by place and dates, confirm the host's Vacation Rental Protocol (VRP) signature, and get a verified offer summary with a link to book directly with the host, on the host's own website. Vacation Rental Protocol is an open standard for host-signed stay offers. Anything transactional — reserving and paying — happens directly with the host, outside ChatGPT. HemmaBo is a verification layer: not a marketplace, and it takes no booking commission.

payload.name: Meeters
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meeters helps users discover currently bookable group trips and weekends, compare public prices and trip details, and continue to the official Meeters page. It only reads the public travel catalog and does not access or change accounts, participants, bookings, orders, or payments.

payload.name: Tralendr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI is great at planning trips and terrible at keeping them usable. Tralendr is the home for AI-planned trips. Ask ChatGPT to plan a trip, then save it to your free Tralendr account, where it becomes a visual day-by-day itinerary with every place on a map, shareable with one link, and ready on your phone while you travel. Plan anywhere, keep it in Tralendr. Free forever.

payload.name: Carhopp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Carhopp finds and compares rental cars at airports, train stations, and cities worldwide. Search live prices from major agencies and local suppliers, filter by category (economy, SUV, van, premium), transmission, price, and free cancellation, then check rental conditions and continue to the provider's secure booking page. Ask things like "rent a car in Barcelona next weekend" or "cheap automatic SUV at CDG airport".

payload.name: OPEN - what is open right now
payload.description: 查看现在哪些地方营业
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OPEN answers one question: is this business open right now, and until when.

Opening hours tell you how a place usually is. OPEN tells you what is true at this moment, because the answer comes from the business owner, who updates it from their phone. A shop that closed early today says so. A place with no fresh information reads UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN is never presented as CLOSED.

Ask in plain language - "what is open near Machane Yehuda right now?", "find a coffee shop that stays open at least another hour" - and the answer arrives with an interactive map inside the conversation. Service professionals are covered too: plumbers, electricians, handymen and locksmiths report whether they are available for work right now.

Four read-only tools: open_now, search_businesses, get_business and list_categories. No sign-in, no writes, no personal data, no advertising.

Coverage: OPEN is in pilot in Jerusalem, Israel, and the catalogue grows through in-person recruitment of business owners. A query about another city will return little or nothing. Hebrew and English.

payload.name: Rio Las Vegas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rio Las Vegas helps guests explore hotel details, room and suite options, images, rates, booking links, cancellation links, and service request confirmations directly in ChatGPT.

payload.name: Shqiponja eSIM
payload.description: 查找 eSIM 数据套餐
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare current eSIM data packages for destinations worldwide. Search by country, data amount, validity period, or maximum price, then review package details directly in ChatGPT. Shqiponja eSIM provides read-only travel connectivity information and does not complete purchases or process payments inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: The Grand Hotel Collection
payload.description: 查找并预订 Grand 酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Grand Hotel Collection makes it easy to discover and book boutique stays in Oregon—right from your AI chat.

Browse rooms with rich photos, compare options side-by-side, and check real-time rates with an interactive calendar. Select your dates, explore amenities, and reserve your stay in just a few taps.

Featuring two distinctive properties: The Grand Hotel at Bridgeport (Tigard) and The Grand Hotel in Salem.

payload.name: Wanderu
payload.description: 搜索美国巴士和火车行程
payload.summaryOriginal: Search US bus and train trips
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and compare bus and train trips across the United States. Wanderu searches major carriers like Greyhound, FlixBus, Amtrak, and more to find you the best routes and prices. See departure times, trip duration, and prices — then book directly on Wanderu.com.

payload.name: NEBLES
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NEBLES Rental Assistant helps users search verified monthly condo rentals in Bangkok, compare rent and move-in costs, inspect room details, and understand the NEBLES booking process through ChatGPT.

payload.name: Bellhopt Concierge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bellhopt helps vacation rental guests request concierge services for their stay.

Guests can browse available services, choose what they need, add stay details, enter the property address, and submit a request for Bellhopt to review. Depending on the location and available services, requests may include pre-arrival groceries, private chef experiences, transportation, spa and massage, arrival setup, celebration setup, and custom stay needs.

Bellhopt is designed for travelers who want a smoother, more prepared vacation rental experience. It gives guests one simple place to request stay services instead of searching for local options or coordinating everything manually.

Submitting a request does not confirm a booking, payment, vendor assignment, host approval, or guaranteed availability. Bellhopt reviews each request and follows up with next steps.

payload.name: tickadoo
payload.description: 查找并预订现场体验活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover theatre, musicals, tours, attractions and events across 700+ cities worldwide. Get real-time pricing and availability, see venue details, and book directly on tickadoo.com. Whether it's a night out in London, sightseeing in New York, or exploring Tokyo — just ask tickadoo ®. What Do You Wanna Doo? ®

payload.name: Fridey
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fridey brings your travel planning into ChatGPT. Connect your Fridey account and let AI help you organize every detail of your trips, from flights and hotels to daily activities and expenses.

What you can do:

📋 View your upcoming and past trips
✈️ Create new trips with destination, dates, and cover image
🏨 Add activities: flights, accommodation, restaurants, transport, and more
✏️ Edit or delete activities and trips
💸 Track expenses and get spending summaries by currency
🗺️ Search destinations for inspiration
Just say things like:
"Create a trip to Tokyo from June 10 to June 20"
"Add a hotel check-in at Park Hyatt on June 11"
"How much have I spent on my Japan trip?"
"Delete the dinner activity from my Bangkok trip"

Fridey is the travel planning app for people who love to explore. Available on iOS, Android, and web at fridey-travel.com

payload.name: Preferred Hotels & Resorts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Leave the ordinary behind. From iconic city landmarks to secluded island sanctuaries, Preferred Hotels & Resorts invites you to discover a world of independent luxury hotels and resorts spanning the globe—each one distinct, each one unforgettable.

 

Tell us where you dream of going and what you long to feel, and we'll curate recommendations matched to your taste. Whether you're drawn to a pristine, white-sand beach, a design-forward urban retreat nestled in the heart of the city, or a grand resort set amidst nature's splendor, we'll help you envision exactly where your next extraordinary journey begins. Explore signature amenities, soak in the details that set each property apart, and discover your next stay in just a few messages.

 

As a member of the I Prefer Hotel Rewards loyalty program, you'll savor exclusive benefits, earn and redeem rewards, and enjoy personalized recognition at participating hotels worldwide. Whether you're planning a long-awaited escape or a last-minute journey, luxury travel begins here.

payload.name: Yoteiko
payload.description: 用 AI 更聪明地规划旅行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Yoteiko is an AI-powered travel planner for destinations worldwide. Search for attractions, restaurants, and hidden gems across any country, then get a personalized day-by-day itinerary built by AI. Whether you're planning a weekend in Paris, a two-week Japan rail trip, or a backpacking adventure through Southeast Asia, Yoteiko creates tailored plans with local recommendations, transit tips, and timing suggestions.

payload.name: Total Parks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Planning a caravan, camping, or cabin trip around Australia?

Total Parks instantly connects you to the same systems the staff use at reception.

Total Parks can help you find holiday parks, caravan parks, and campgrounds by destination, features, room or site details, trip vibe, dates, guests, pets, and rig details, then check the real facts before you commit. 

Ask for parks near a place, options that look open for a travel window, powered or ensuite sites, accessible or spa cabins, whether a park welcomes dogs, if your caravan or motorhome will fit a site, or what a cabin actually includes - and get answers based on current Total Parks listing, capability, policy, and planning availability checks instead of guesswork. 

Every answer links back to totalparks.com.au, and when a stay looks like a good fit you'll get a booking link with your dates, guests, and pet or rig details already filled in.

payload.name: Porcel hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Porcel hotels Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat.
Users can ask questions about Porcel hotels, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
If a guest already has a reservation, the assistant can retrieve reservation details and help modify or cancel an existing booking when the required reservation information is provided.
The assistant can also help create a new booking and send support requests to the hotel if a guest needs assistance.
Example questions you can ask:
“What time is check-in at Porcel hotels?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me available room types.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”
“Contact the hotel for help with my reservation.”

Note: Some reservation actions may require providing booking details such as reservation code or guest information.

payload.name: FlatHunt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FlatHunt helps people find furnished apartments, studios, and private rooms in Berlin from multiple trusted housing providers.

Search by location, monthly budget, property type, number of rooms, size, move-in date, amenities, and other preferences. FlatHunt compares matching listings, presents the most relevant options in interactive cards, and links to the original provider page for current details and availability.

FlatHunt is designed for expats, professionals, students, couples, and anyone looking for furnished accommodation in Berlin.

Listings, prices, and availability may change. FlatHunt helps users discover and compare housing options but does not act as a landlord, property manager, or booking provider.

payload.name: TravCozy
payload.summaryOriginal: All your trips in one place
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TravCozy keeps every part of your trip together. Ask ChatGPT about your travels and it answers from your real bookings — flights, hotels, trains, car rentals, and transfers imported from any booking site — organized into a day-by-day itinerary.

It also spots what's missing before you travel: nights without accommodation and arrivals with no onward transport. Add bookings right from the conversation by describing them, by uploading a confirmation file, or by forwarding booking emails to your TravCozy inbox — they're organized into the right trip automatically.

Requires a TravCozy account (travcozy.com).

payload.name: ride.auto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and book unique vehicles for rent, from everyday cars to Teslas, trucks, and SUVs. Search by location, dates, and vehicle type, compare pricing with full cost breakdowns, and book directly through the marketplace.

payload.name: Sobo Beaches
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sobo Beaches helps you find and book beach huts for your holiday. Tell ChatGPT where and when you want to go, your budget, and what matters most (location, view, dog friendly, accessibility). The app returns matching huts with key details and a link to complete your booking on sobobeaches.com.

payload.name: MeranO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With the app of the city of Merano (South Tyrol, Italy) you always get up-to-date information on events,  hotels and accommodations, bike tours, hiking trails,  a gastronomy guide and much more. Discover Merano, its extensive parks and green promenades at any time of the year. The diverse cultural offerings range from the Merano Spring to the traditional "Traubenfest" and the Merano Christmas Markets, up to the Südtirol Festival Merano to the Merano WineFestival. Use your AI tool to plan your holiday at MeranO.

payload.name: Traffik Yacht Radar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Traffik measures the movement of the world's superyachts and private aviation from live public safety broadcasts. Ask for the weekly Traffik Index (100 = an ordinary week on the water), the measured pulse of any tracked yachting harbor — Monaco, Newport, Miami, Porto Cervo, the Hamptons and 150 more — plus private jets and helicopters into executive airports, or measured superyacht attendance at marquee events like the Monaco Grand Prix. Every number is a floor, not an estimate: only broadcasting vessels inside named geofences are counted, and every answer states its method and date.

payload.name: Kindred
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kindred is a global home-swapping community that turns every stay into a doorway to richer, more meaningful travel. Revolutionizing the way people travel by introducing a new model built on trust, connection, and member hosted homes — an alternative to both hotels and short-term rentals that makes travel more accessible, more conscientious, and more authentic.

Search by destination, dates, and guests to discover homes around the world. Explore thoughtfully curated spaces for a long weekend or extended adventure. Connect with local hosts who share their favorite neighborhood recommendations that help you travel more like a local.

payload.name: The Houstonian
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Houstonian app for ChatGPT makes it easy to learn about The Houstonian Hotel, Club & Spa in Houston, Texas. You can ask questions and quickly get helpful information about the hotel’s amenities, services, and general details—all within the conversation.

You can also check current room rates and availability without leaving ChatGPT. This makes it convenient for travelers, event planners, or anyone interested in the hotel to see up-to-date information while planning a visit.

By bringing this information directly into ChatGPT, the app provides a simple way to explore the hotel, learn what it offers, and review current pricing to help you decide if it’s the right place for your stay.

Note:
Responses are generated using artificial intelligence and may occasionally contain inaccuracies. The information provided is for general guidance only. Please avoid sharing sensitive personal information.

payload.name: DRAIV
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DRAIV is keyless car rental in Zurich, Switzerland. Ask for what you need — an SUV for the weekend, an electric car tonight, a seven-seater for the family — and DRAIV shows what is actually free, with real prices in Swiss francs and a direct link to book.

There is no rental counter, no key handover and no deposit blocked on your card. You unlock the car with your phone, so pickup works at any hour, including after a late flight. Cars stand at fixed locations across Zurich (City, Altstetten, Oerlikon) and at Zurich Airport, where you collect the car right at the terminal parking on rentals of two days or more.

Booking finishes on draiv.ch in your browser. No app to install.

payload.name: pickthehotel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
pickthehotel is an answer engine for hotels. Instead of a wall of results, ask for the one hotel that fits your intent in a city and get a single confident pick, a few alternatives, and a booking link.

Choose an intent:
• iconic - the standout in town
• value - great, and fairly priced for what you get
• budget - cheap, clean, and genuinely central
• family - one room that actually sleeps two adults and the children

Every hotel is judged the same way - value (punching above its price), location (closeness to what you actually came for), and reviews (weighted by confidence, not just averaged) - with no paid placement. You can anchor "central" to a landmark ("near the Louvre") or to your live location, and you can ask for a curated list of long-established hotels around the world.

Live in Zürich, Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Bangkok, Dubai, Singapore, Istanbul, and Hong Kong, with more rolling out. Prices are indicative and confirmed at the booking site; booking links are affiliate and disclosed.

payload.name: Airside Labs Aviation Tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Aviation reference tools for analysts, researchers and product teams. Resolve airports, airlines, aircraft types, registrations and flight identifiers with confidence, historical validity and source provenance. Inspect airport network integration, operator and ownership facts, engagement exceptions, connectivity and passenger-size bands. Explore a catalogue of aviation AI use cases, their data requirements, message lineage and an EASA framework screen. Reference and research data only: not live operational, flight-status, booking or safety-control information. Users can also submit product feedback for human review.

payload.name: Ognissanti Hotels
payload.description: 查找佛罗伦萨酒店和导览
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and book rooms across the 7 Ognissanti Hotels in Florence: Palazzina Fusi, Hotel Lombardia, Hotel Arcadia, Hotel Villa Betania, L'Antica Porta, Residenza Ognissanti, and        
  Novella's Apartment.                                                                                                                                                                    
                                         
  Ask in plain language ("a quiet double near the Duomo for two nights in May") and the app returns live availability with real prices, photos, and a direct booking link from our        
  reservation system. You can generate a personalized quotation on the spot.           
                                                                                                                                                                                          
  You can also browse Florence experiences from our partner Ciao Florence — skip-the-line Uffizi tours, Tuscan wine tastings, Vespa rentals, cooking classes, day trips to Pisa and Siena 
  — each with a direct booking link.     
                                                                                                                                                                                          
  No login required. Booking and payment happen through our HotelInCloud reservation system, not inside the chat.

payload.name: RezervaOnline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RezervaOnline helps travelers find and book accommodation across Romania — guesthouses (pensiuni), hotels and villas. Search properties by locality or name, check real-time room availability and prices in Romanian lei (RON), and create a reservation directly in the conversation. Reservations are confirmed by the property and payment is made on arrival, so no online payment is required to book. RezervaOnline connects you to properties that manage their bookings on the RezervaOnline platform.

payload.name: HeyYumi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HeyYumi helps you find where to eat, drink, or go out in Korea — restaurants, cafes, bakeries, dessert shops, and bars — and book a table without leaving the chat. Every venue comes from Yumi's own refined, cross-verified dataset (346,000+ venues, strongest in Seoul, Gyeonggi, Busan and Jeju), each shipping with a confidence score and a last-checked date so answers stay grounded rather than guessed. Narrow results by 40+ food & drink attributes — neighborhood/station/landmark, cuisine, price, atmosphere, parking, pet-friendly, private room, vegan options, English-speaking staff, open-now, and more. At Yumi partner venues you can send a real reservation request to the owner right inside ChatGPT and get a confirmed/declined answer back.

payload.name: Andeor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore current experiences across Mauritius with current marketplace facts from Andeor. Compare starting prices, duration, location and difficulty, and check published departures for your party. The public app is informational and does not provide external links or transactional actions.

payload.name: Powly
payload.description: 阿尔卑斯滑雪场与雪况
payload.summaryOriginal: Ski resorts & snow in the Alps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 1,486 ski resorts in the Alps (AT, CH, DE, IT, FR, SI). Get snow forecasts, resort details, driving times from any city, powder-day alerts, side-by-side resort comparisons, and route maps. Data includes piste kilometers, lifts, elevation, glacier status, current snow depth, ski passes, and 16-day weather forecasts from Open-Meteo. Ask things like: "Which ski resorts are within 2 hours of Stuttgart?" - "Where is the most snow next week?" - "Soelden or Ischgl, which is bigger?" - "Show me the route to Zermatt".

payload.name: Parra-Glideator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Parra-Glideator helps pilots narrow down where and when conditions look most promising. Its read-only tools rank sites for selected dates, compare forecast-derived XC potential, show stored site overviews and historical seasonality, return launch and landing information, and surface curated local resources such as club pages, webcams, and meteostations. Results are decision support only: pilots must verify current conditions, local rules, airspace, access, and suitability for their skills and equipment before flying.

payload.name: Vize Rehberim
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).

It answers questions like "Do I need a visa for Japan?", "How much does a German visa cost?" and "How many Schengen days do I have left?" — always with its source.

What it covers:

· Visa status for 172 countries — 55 visa-free, 23 visa on arrival, 30 e-visa, 64 requiring a consulate application
· Per country: the fee, the published processing time, the application centre and the required documents
· Refusal rates for Schengen applications made from Türkiye, based on European Commission statistics (27 countries)
· Appealing a refusal: the competent authority, deadline, language and fee for seven Schengen countries, and the meaning of all 17 refusal grounds on the standard form
· Calculators: the Schengen 90/180 day allowance, multiple-entry (cascade) eligibility, and the total cost in Turkish lira at the central bank rate

How the data is collected:

Every amount and duration is verified against an official consulate, ministry or legislative source, quoted verbatim. A value that cannot be verified is not published — nothing is estimated; the field is left empty and said to be empty. Answers carry their source and last-updated date.

Only the consulate of the country concerned can grant a visa. We are not an agency: we do not file applications, book appointments, or guarantee approval.

payload.name: Travon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Travon helps travelers view and understand their trip plans directly in ChatGPT.

You can use Travon to check your saved trips, review flights, hotels, activities, packing items, and other travel details, and ask questions about your itinerary in a natural way.

This ChatGPT app is read-only for now, so it helps you explore your existing travel information without changing your trip.
